SNDK.thesis_short: NAND/SSD supplier on allocation; enterprise SSD for AI inference; record margins.
kill_criteria: NAND or enterprise SSD contract prices fall quarter on quarter (TrendForce or company commentary)
SanDisk says NAND is no longer on allocation, or guides revenue or gross margin below the prior quarter
A large cloud provider cuts or flattens its 2027 capex plan
Samsung, SK hynix or Kioxia pull new NAND fab output forward into 1H27
PC or phone makers report rising NAND inventory or cut SSD content further

key_dependencies.name: Kioxia (joint venture partner)
key_dependencies.why: shared NAND fabs and capacity decisions

key_dependencies.name: PC and phone makers
key_dependencies.why: client SSD and mobile NAND demand

MU.thesis_short: DRAM + HBM leader; supply tight through 2028; 87% gross margin; 2027 HBM largely sold.
kill_criteria: DRAM contract prices flat or down quarter on quarter
Micron guides gross margin down or revenue below consensus
A large cloud provider cuts or flattens its 2027 capex plan
CXMT qualifies HBM at a major customer or starts discounting DRAM
Samsung or SK hynix bring large new DRAM capacity forward from 2028 into 2027
HBM long-term agreements renegotiated or volumes cut

key_dependencies.name: Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta
key_dependencies.why: cloud capex drives server DRAM and HBM demand

key_dependencies.name: SK hynix / Samsung
key_dependencies.why: competing DRAM/HBM supply and capacity decisions

STX.thesis_short: Nearline HDD for AI data centres; HAMR ramp; disciplined supply; margins rising 13 quarters.
kill_criteria: Seagate guides revenue or margin down, or says nearline lead times are shortening
HAMR / Mozaic ramp delayed or qualification problems at a large customer
A large cloud provider cuts or flattens its 2027 capex plan
Western Digital or Seagate announce meaningful HDD capacity additions (supply discipline breaks)

key_dependencies.name: Western Digital
key_dependencies.why: only major HDD competitor; supply discipline

memory.verdict: Peak earnings, not yet peak pricing: Q4 2026 contract prices still rising (DRAM +10-15%, NAND +15-20%). 2027 split: DRAM stays short, NAND supply catches up from 2H27. Stocks are volatile and have sold off three times since July without fundamental change.

signals.signal: Contract prices turn negative quarter on quarter
SanDisk ends allocation / enterprise SSD prices fall
CXMT HBM qualified at a major customer or price cuts

storage_hdd.verdict: Different cycle from memory: few suppliers, slow capacity additions, AI bulk-storage demand reported locked in through 2028. Main risk is a slowdown in data-centre spending.
